what_IS_established.the_parser_works: Every generation that closed the tag yielded an answer under 40 chars -- 8/8 at budget_512. mean chars RAW ~1822 vs PARSED 6-8 is the signature of the defect the extractor fixes: without it the judge scores the TRACE. what_IS_established.sequential_eval_is_infeasible: 30 s/question at 512 tokens. The 626-question arm would take 5.2 h with 64 % truncated = garbage. The rung as designed cannot be run. (2026-08-17: the '115.6 s at 2048 -> 20 h / ~$42' half of this sentence rested on the RETRACTED budget_2048 block and is removed; the 512 half stands on its own and reaches the same conclusion.)
what_IS_established.the_bottleneck_is_OUR_HARNESS_not_thinki: The same model, same thinking, through vLLM continuous batching measures 1.33 s/question (RESULTS_batched_thinking.json). Our eval path is ~100x slower than production because screen_engine generates one question at a time in HF transformers.

what_is_NOT_established.does_our_SFT_break_thinking: Unknown. The base 27B closed in a median of 177 tokens on synthetic questions; this checkpoint truncates far more on real ones. That could be the fine-tuning OR the harder real prompts -- two variables moved at once, and the char-cap confound sits on top.
what_is_NOT_established.does_thinking_help_accuracy: Not measured. enforce_latency=True marks 22/22 responses incorrect on the clock alone, so no accuracy read from this smoke means anything.

decision_required: Rung 43's eval must be rewritten for vLLM batched (~14 min for 626 questions at the measured rate), or the rung closes as NOT MEASURABLE with the current harness. It must NOT be reported as a verdict about reasoning.
